title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 20 JUNE 2026 Issued at 05.30 a.m. on 20 June 2026. Several spells of showers will occur in Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-western provinces and in Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places in Uva and Eastern provinces and in Mullaitivu district after 2.00 p.m. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
